name: Marqii
oneLiner: Digital operations platform for restaurants that keeps menus, listings, reviews and social posts up to date from one dashboard, with POS menu sync, AI-suggested review replies and review generation.
bestFor: Multi-location restaurant brands and franchisees that want menu and listing accuracy plus review response handled in one restaurant-specific tool, with published per-location pricing.

updates.text: Launched Social Management for scheduling posts to Facebook and Google Business Profile from Marqii, with more channels and features planned.
Launched First Party Reviews: branded review forms shared by link, QR code or website embed, with results included in Marqii's review insights.
Launched Review Generation with Thanx: after a purchase, Marqii sends guests a text inviting them to review the restaurant on Google, Facebook or TripAdvisor.

features: Menu management that syncs POS menu changes to Google, Yelp, Facebook, Apple Maps and other sites, with menus marked up so search engines and AI bots can read them
Listings management with unlimited updates to 70+ listings publishers: hours, photos, holidays, dining attributes, contact info, specials and offers, and preferred ordering links
Review monitoring on Yelp, Google, Facebook, DoorDash, Grubhub, Uber Eats and ezCater, with review responses on Yelp, Google and Facebook (Growth plan and up)
Review widgets, custom review notifications, review insights with sentiment analysis and AI review summaries
Suggested Review Response: one-click AI drafts with customizable prompts and tone settings for positive, neutral and negative reviews, 'suggested by AI, approved by you' (Scale plan and up)

Managed Review Response: Marqii's team writes replies on Google, Yelp and Facebook for brands with more than 50 reviews per month, escalates critical reviews and holds monthly check-ins on sentiment, response trends and keywords

Review Generation: when guests order through a Marqii partner, a templated text links them to leave a review (Google, Facebook, TripAdvisor or Marqii First Party Reviews); branded first-party review forms shared by link, QR code or website embed
Social Management with Google Posts and Apple Showcase
Host: SEO and GEO-optimized location pages with embedded menus and hours; hours, menu and FAQ website widgets; an MCP server connection to AI platforms

pricing.text: Published per location per month on an annual contract: Base (listings + menus) $90, Growth (adds reviews) $145, Scale (full suite: AI-suggested replies, review generation, social) $180, Marqii Package (adds Host location pages) $250. Add-ons: Managed Review Response bundles of 50/100/250/500 reviews at $100/$150/$250/$375 per month ($2.00 to $0.75 per review; platform fee if bought standalone); Review Generation platform fee $100 per month per brand (included in Scale and Marqii Package) plus $15 per bundle of 1,000 SMS. No free trial; free demo.

notes: Pricing and plans read on marqii.com/pricing in November 2026 (curl); the tiers changed since the last check (new Growth, Scale and Marqii Package plans; AI-suggested replies moved into Scale). The pricing page lists review responses on Yelp, Google and Facebook only, and monitoring for DoorDash, Grubhub, Uber Eats and ezCater; OpenTable is no longer named, so it was dropped. G2 lists Marqii with a single review, too few for a rating, so none is cited. Marqii claims 15,000+ restaurants on its homepage; vendor figure, not used. Case-study metrics (e.g. Romulus 94% response rate) are vendor-reported. The 'response time under 30 seconds' claim on the Suggested Review Response page is a vendor claim, not used.
pros: Built only for restaurants: POS menu sync, delivery and catering review monitoring, restaurant-specific reply prompts
Published per-location prices for every plan and add-on
Two ways to answer reviews: AI drafts a manager approves (Scale and up) or done-for-you replies from Marqii's team, priced per review
Listings, menus, reviews, social posts and location pages in one dashboard, with unlimited updates to 70+ listings publishers
Review insights with sentiment analysis and AI review summaries

cons.text: No free trial or free plan; Marqii offers a free demo
Plans are billed per location on an annual contract
Replies only on Google, Yelp and Facebook; DoorDash, Grubhub, Uber Eats and ezCater reviews are monitored only
Base ($90) has no review tools; AI-suggested replies start on Scale ($180 per location per month)
Host location pages come only with the Marqii Package ($250 per location per month)
Managed replies and review-generation texts cost extra (from $100 per month), and review texts go only to guests who order through a Marqii partner
Built only for restaurants, so brands outside hospitality need another tool
